key_findings.flat_v26_zoom_quality: FAIL - All 4 TF-IDF modes fail frozen v26 rule: severe over-fragmentation (median cluster size 1, >99% singletons at res_3.0), no branch/area monotonicity, strict nesting < 1.0 at coarse transitions (0.44-0.90)
key_findings.constrained_hierarchical_leiden_174k_tfi: PASS - 4/4 TF-IDF modes pass hierarchical zoom test: nesting=1.0 by construction, zero fragmentation (singleton fraction < 0.1%), branch purity delta +0.03 to +0.09, area purity delta +0.03 to +0.13, zoom coherence improvement_rate 57-90% (3/4 modes > 0.5)
key_findings.constrained_hierarchical_leiden_99k_dens: FAIL v26 - Strong absolute purity (branch 0.986, area 0.602) and zero fragmentation (0.16% singletons), but improvement_rate=47.37% misses 50% threshold. Positive scale trend from 12k (45.45%) → 99k (47.37%).
key_findings.scale_dependency_confirmed: 12k dense: improvement_rate=45.45%; 99k dense: improvement_rate=47.37%; 174k TF-IDF: improvement_rate=57-90%. Dense embeddings show improving trend with scale but have not crossed v26 threshold at 99k.
key_findings.nesting_metric_defect_v1: CONFIRMED - Compressed ladder passes trivially for by-construction hierarchies but is not universally valid for meaningful legal structure. Flat independent clustering fails nesting at scale.

accepted_claims: Constrained hierarchical Leiden (min_cluster_size + adaptive sub_resolution) on 174k TF-IDF embeddings produces a valid multi-resolution hierarchy with perfect nesting, zero fragmentation, and measurable zoom refinement
The hierarchy is legally meaningful: branch purity improves from coarse to fine (e.g., cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: 0.4320 -> 0.4906), area purity improves (0.1541 -> 0.2440)
This method is CPU-feasible and production-ready for TF-IDF modes at full 174k scale
Flat independent Leiden at multiple resolutions is NOT a valid fractal map method at 174k scale (fails v26 frozen rule)

Dense embeddings (center_projected) at 99k scale achieve near-perfect branch purity (0.986) and strong area purity (0.602) with zero fragmentation, but zoom refinement rate (47.37%) remains below v26 threshold
